reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that redacts credentials and other sensitive material from model-visible input, output, tool-call arguments, and related session surfaces using built-in and configurable replacement rules.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型输入、输出、工具调用参数和相关会话内容中按规则替换敏感信息的插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that replaces sensitive information in model inputs, outputs, tool-call arguments, and related session content according to configured rules.

capabilities: Redacts sensitive values from agent input streams
Redacts sensitive values from model output and tool-call argument streams
Applies built-in and configurable custom regex and exact-word replacement rules
Rewrites session-visible content while preserving original append-origin events in the durable log
